records.title: 10-Q
records.text: At March 31, 2025, our dollar-based net revenue retention rate increased from the year ended December 31, 2024 due to a higher rate of acquiring customer accounts and the impact of favorable foreign exchange rates.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: At March 31, 2025, we had 393,892 individual users across 4,455 customers.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: For the quarters ended March 31, 2025 and 2024, we had revenues totaling $166.9 million and $157.5 million, respectively.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: •$1.2 million increase in computer software expenses due to higher spend on cloud hosting services as customers continue to migrate to the Google Cloud Platform (“GCP”), as well as upgrades to support business growth;

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: For the quarter ended March 31, 2025, cash provided by operating activities was $46.7 million, resulting from net non-cash expenses of approximately $28.9 million, net cash flows provided as a result of changes in operating assets and liabilities of $12.6 million, and net income of $5.3 million.
